source.paraphrase: Secret client variables are not supported. A schema cannot set both context: "client" and access: "secret".

invariants.why: A client variable is bundled into the browser. Marking it secret does not keep the value on the server.
invariants.fixHint: Use context: "server" with access: "secret", and read the value from astro:env/server. A public client variable uses context: "client" and access: "public".
invariants.avoid: A computed context or access is not read. Importing astro:env/server into a module that a client:* island pulls in is a template-graph question and stays out of this check.

source.work: Astro documentation, on-demand rendering (https://docs.astro.build/en/guides/on-demand-rendering/) and configuration reference (https://docs.astro.build/en/reference/configuration-reference/#output)
source.paraphrase: output: "server" renders every page on demand, and on-demand rendering requires an adapter.

invariants.why: Without an adapter, the server build has no runtime to render those pages.
invariants.fixHint: Import an adapter such as @astrojs/node and set adapter on the same defineConfig object. Leave output at "static" until a page opts out of prerender.
invariants.avoid: A spread config or a defineConfig argument that is not an object literal is not inspected. output: "static" with prerender = false in a page still needs an adapter, and that export lives in the page.
